Hickory Road,
[[Hickory Corners, Michigan]] 49060 | type = [[Automobile museum]] | collection = 400+ antique cars, motorcycles, & more | visitors = 127,000 (annually) | director = Michael Spezia | president = | curator = | publictransit = | car_park = | network = | website = {{URL|gilmorecarmuseum.org}} }} The '''Gilmore Car Museum''' is an [[automobile museum]] located in [[Hickory Corners, Michigan|Hickory Corners]], [[Michigan]], United States. The museum exhibits over 400 vintage and collector vehicles and motorcycles from all eras in several vintage buildings located on a 90-acre campus.{{cite web |url = http://www.gilmorecarmuseum.org |title = Gilmore Car Museum |access-date = April 22, 2014 }} The museum claims to be the largest automobile museum in North America. It is part of the [[MotorCities National Heritage Area]].{{Cite web|title=History & Mission|url=https://gilmorecarmuseum.org/about/history-and-mission|access-date=2022-02-24|website=Gilmore Car Museum|language=en}} The museum opened in 1966 exhibiting the car collection of [[Donald S. Gilmore]], a local businessman. Today, its collection consists of over 400 vehicles, including an [[Steam car|1899 Locomobile Steam Car]] and a 1930 Rolls-Royce prop car used in the 1967 film ''[[The Gnome-Mobile]]''. The museum also claims to have the largest display of automotive mascots and name badges in North America. The campus includes a 1941 Blue Moon [[Diner]] and a replica 1930s Shell fuel station. It is [[North America]]'s largest [[automobile museum]] with 190,00 square feet of exhibit space. [[File:Gilmore Car Museum, Hickory Corners, Michigan USA - Model A Ford Museum.JPG|thumb|The Model A Ford Museum]] ==Partner museums== Seven smaller, independent museums are located on the Gilmore Car Museum campus:{{cite web|title=Partner Museums|url=http://www.gilmorecarmuseum.org/visit-explore-2/partner-museums/|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170803055944/http://www.gilmorecarmuseum.org/visit-explore-2/partner-museums/|archive-date=August 3, 2017|access-date=October 28, 2017|website=Gilmore Car Museum|publisher=Gilmore Car Museum}} * [[Classic Car Club of America]] Museum * Model A Ford Museum * Lincoln Motor Car Heritage Museum * Cadillac & LaSalle Club Museum & Research Center * Pierce-Arrow Museum * Franklin Automobile Collection * Museum of the Horseless Carriage The Midwest Miniatures Museum was based on the Gilmore campus until its relocation to [[Grand Haven, Michigan|Grand Haven]] in 2020.{{Cite web|date=2019-12-03|title=Visit|url=https://www.midwestminiaturesmuseum.com/visit|url-status=unfit|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191224174806/http://www.midwestminiaturesmuseum.com/plan-a-visit|archive-date=2019-12-24|access-date=2021-11-20|website=Midwest Miniatures Museum|language=en-US}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== {{Commons category}} *[http://www.gilmorecarmuseum.org Official site] {{authority control}} [[Category:Automobile museums in Michigan]] [[Category:Museums in Barry County, Michigan]] [[Category:Museums established in 1966]] [[Category:1966 establishments in Michigan]] {{Michigan-museum-stub}}
